original_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. White-background 3D drama prop reference board, six clearly separated complete object groups in a spacious 3 by 2 grid, highest native quality landscape3:2. Top row: simple aged brass mechanical shop doorbell with mounting bracket and striker; mixed small generic coins plus clearly fictional plain muted green prop banknotes with no currency insignia or readable words; plain brass small key with sage cord. Bottom row: cream ceramic pour-over coffee dripper on transparent glass carafe and small steel gooseneck kettle together as one group; unbranded smartphone in muted burgundy silicone case front with black screen and rear together; removable small oak cash drawer with keyhole and empty compartments, shown open as one complete object. Soft neutral studio light, realistic natural 3D material detail, no orange cast, pure white background and subtle contact shadows. NO hands/people/animals/mannequin/room/watermark/captions/logos. This is a production reference board, not individual cropped assets.
